description: Which versions of a product are already end of life? Lists the release cycles past their end-of-life date, newest first, with the end-of-life date, the last patch version and whether extended (often paid) support is still available. Useful for security audits and spotting outdated versions in an estate. Source: endoflife.date (community-maintained); it reports published dates, not whether a given install is patched. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, cycles to return, newest first, 1-100, default 25

product.description: string, required, endoflife.date product slug (e.g. php, python, nodejs)

name: eol_unsupported_releases
